calibrationReview.note: The archived OPEN lane issued no BET risk; repricing is compared without outcome-chasing or duplicate exposure.

recommendations.title: San Francisco Giants moneyline
recommendations.mechanism: Fresh two-book MLB repricing tests whether an improved underdog quote clears no-vig fair.
recommendations.limitation: The best quote remains below fair and movement can be noisy.
recommendations.displayText: B — direct MLB moneyline/no-vig evidence fits; market efficiency and movement noise limit the case.

recommendations.title: Toronto Blue Jays moneyline
recommendations.mechanism: Two-book MLB no-vig and same-day price movement assess whether a small improvement creates value.
recommendations.limitation: The move is small and the best quote remains below fair.
recommendations.displayText: B — direct MLB moneyline/no-vig evidence fits; a small repricing does not overcome market efficiency.

recommendations.title: Atlanta Braves moneyline
recommendations.mechanism: Single-book MLB no-vig establishes a conservative fair baseline after loss of line-shopping depth.
recommendations.limitation: Only one supported executable quote remains.
recommendations.displayText: B — direct MLB no-vig evidence fits; one-book calibration and no price cushion reduce confidence.

recommendations.title: St. Louis Cardinals moneyline
recommendations.mechanism: Single-book MLB calibration measures whether the improved price clears fair value.
recommendations.limitation: The second supported book is unavailable and edge remains negative.
recommendations.displayText: B — direct MLB moneyline calibration fits; one-book fair and a negative edge remain cautionary.

recommendations.title: Beşiktaş–Kauno Žalgiris draw
recommendations.mechanism: Three-way no-vig and soccer market structure evaluate a longshot draw after a book disappears.
recommendations.limitation: Only one supported quote remains and direct playoff-draw calibration is limited.
recommendations.displayText: C — soccer 1X2 and margin evidence fits; direct playoff-draw calibration remains limited.

recommendations.title: Lech Poznań–FC Thun draw
recommendations.mechanism: Two-book three-way no-vig identifies whether the best draw price exceeds consensus fair.
recommendations.limitation: The residual is tiny, books disagree, and round-specific calibration is limited.
recommendations.displayText: C — soccer market-efficiency evidence is relevant; league/round specificity and book dispersion limit fit.
